info.name: E-Commerce Platform API
info.description:
Complete API reference for the E-Commerce Platform with 87 endpoints across 14 modules.

## Getting Started
1. Set `base_url` to your API.
2. For a new client, set the registration environment fields, run Register, and verify the emailed token.
3. Run Login after verification; the collection saves the access and refresh tokens.
4. Authenticated requests use `Bearer {{access_token}}`.

Use credentials provisioned for your environment; no client credentials are included in this collection.

## Response Envelope
All responses follow: `{ success: bool, data: T, meta: { page, per_page, total, total_pages, request_id } }`
Error: `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details } }`

item.name: 🏪 Vendors
item.description: Vendor onboarding: run 1 → 4 in order, then use the Vendor: requests. Steps 2-3 need an ADMIN login first (Auth → Login).

request.description: Step 1: the seller registers as a normal user. Saves vendor_user_id (needed in step 2).
Step 2 (ADMIN token): turns the user into a VENDOR (status PENDING). commission_bps 1000 = 10%. Saves vendor_id.
Step 3 (ADMIN token): APPROVED vendors can use /vendor routes and sell. Also accepts PENDING or SUSPENDED.
Step 4: log in AFTER the role change so the token carries role VENDOR. Saves vendor_access_token (admin access_token is untouched).
List vendors (filter by status).
Get one vendor.

VENDOR token. vendor_id is taken from the token, never from the body. Prices are whole BDT taka. Saves vendor_product_id.

item.name: 📥 Stock & Fulfillment
item.description: Daily operations. Receive stock when you buy. COD orders take stock when placed; online orders take it when payment completes; cancelling puts it back. Shipping only records courier and tracking.

request.description: Record stock you bought. Adds units to inventory (creating the stock record if new), sets each variant's cost_price to the weighted-average cost, and saves the purchase. SKUs must already exist as products. unit_cost is whole BDT per unit. Response shows stock and cost before/after per SKU.
Newest first. Filter by supplier_name.
One purchase with per-SKU stock and cost changes.
Your pick-and-pack list: paid orders waiting to ship.
Cash-on-delivery only: records that the money was collected (payment_status UNPAID -> PAID).

PAID, CONFIRMED (COD) or PROCESSING -> SHIPPED. Saves the courier and tracking number. Stock is not touched here. Safe to retry. Optional courier_cost = what the courier charged you (whole BDT); it feeds net profit in the reports.
Items at or below their low-stock threshold: what to reorder.

item.name: 📊 Reports
item.description: Admin-only profit reports. Gross profit = item revenue - cost of goods (cost frozen on each order when placed). Net profit = gross + shipping charged - courier cost (enter courier_cost when shipping). Payment-gateway fees and ad spend are not included.

request.description: Headline numbers for the period plus a daily (group_by=month for monthly) trend. Dates are Bangladesh dates, both inclusive. Defaults: this month so far, SHIPPED and DELIVERED orders. items_missing_cost > 0 means some order items have no recorded cost, so profit is overstated.
Best products by gross profit. Use sort=worst to find what loses money or earns least.
Revenue, cost and profit of each order, newest first.

item.name: 🛒 Orders
item.description: Order management: create, list, admin operations.

request.description:
Send only product_id, variant_id and quantity per item. Price, name, SKU and vendor come from the catalog.
payment_method: COD (confirmed at once, stock taken at once) or ONLINE.
ONLINE with wallets configured (PAYMENT_BKASH_NUMBER etc.) also needs payment_provider (bkash|nagad|rocket), payment_reference (TrxID) and payer_number; the order waits in PAYMENT_PENDING until an admin confirms the payment, then stock is taken.
shipping_method: standard | express. The delivery fee is set by the server (see Checkout config). shipping_address.name and phone are required.
coupon_code (optional): validated by the server; invalid codes return 422 with the reason.
delivery_area: inside_dhaka (default) or outside_dhaka. The delivery fee comes from the shop's Delivery charges (admin), never from the request.
Authenticated: list the current user orders.
Authenticated: get a single order by ID.
Admin: list all orders with optional filters.
Admin: update order status (PENDING→CONFIRMED→PROCESSING→SHIPPED→DELIVERED or CANCELLED/REFUNDED).
